weather.blurb: Hot, and the index says it feels hotter. Shade and water if you are out.

air.blurb: Clear air. A great day to be outside.

lake.blurb: The lake is close to full — good for boats and for the summer water supply. Down a touch from last week.

pollen.note: Tree 2 · Grass 3 · Weed 3 · Grasses, Ragweed, Elm
pollen.blurb: Grasses, ragweed and elm are all working. Take the pill before it takes you.

grid.blurb: A busy afternoon: demand near 82,400 megawatts, with 105,300 on hand.

sun.blurb: Long light still. The last hour before it goes is the only comfortable one.
